description: Free weekly change feed for care homes in England: newly registered or listed, no longer listed, registered provider changed, overall rating published or changed, new inspection date, recorded beds changed, renamed. Each comparison is between two complete DataScoop imports of CQC's active register; dates are import dates, not event dates. Rating corrections from the dated CQC workbook supplement are excluded unless change_type is rating_correction. Filter by exact local authority. Cite the page_url returned.

local_authority.description: Exact local authority name as published by CQC, e.g. "Surrey" (case-insensitive)

name: get_care_home_changes
title: Get weekly care-home changes
